mapper.select: insert into abr_share (share_code, kind, visitor_id, ref_id, options, render_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{shareCode}, #{kind}, #{visitorId}, #{refId}, cast(#{options} as jsonb), 1, now(), now()) on conflict (kind, visitor_id, ref_id) do update set options = excluded.options, render_count = abr_share.render_count + 1, update_time = now() returning share_code
